items.title: Manuel Paul Interview, 1960-04-19
items.q: Now, this is me right here. Right here. Right behind Willie Humphred. See where they're at? Oh, yeah. And I'm right behind him.

ctx.x: Oh, you did? Uh-huh. In Clarinet. And this fellow right here, you know who he is, Willie Humphrey. Yeah.
Who's that between Willie and the... This is Henry Harden.
